prompt: In this photorealistic photo, a lively wedding reception unfolds under warm ambient light. On the left side of the frame, an elderly woman in a floral dress sits on a wooden chair, her posture relaxed as she holds a crystal glass. Next to her stands a tall man in a navy suit, who is pointing toward the center of the room with his right hand. In the center, a bride in a white lace gown looks at a groom in a black tuxedo, their faces illuminated by soft candlelight. The groom is handing a small velvet box to the bride, creating a focal point of intimacy amidst the crowd. Behind them, a large tiered cake with white frosting rests on a round table, its details sharp and inviting. To the right of the cake, a young boy in a blue vest reaches for a slice, his eyes wide with anticipation. Standing next to the boy is a woman in a green silk dress, who is looking at him with a gentle smile. In the background, a band member in a sequined jacket plays a silver saxophone, his body swaying slightly to the rhythm. A golden retriever dog lies on the polished floor near the band, its head resting on its paws. Above the dance floor, a chandelier hangs from the ceiling, casting intricate shadows. A waiter in a white apron walks past the chandelier, carrying a tray of champagne flutes. On the far right, an older man in a gray beard leans against a pillar, observing the scene. A little girl in a pink dress runs past the pillar, her hair flowing behind her. A photographer in a black shirt crouches near the girl, aiming a large camera lens at the couple. There is no smoke in the air. There is no digital clock visible on any wall.
